# API reference

Generated from the source of `github.com/otfabric/go-ocpp` with `docsync api`; the doc comments are the documentation. The guides around it explain how the pieces fit.

| Package | Synopsis |
|---|---|
| [github.com/otfabric/go-ocpp](go-ocpp.md) | Package ocpp holds what the OCPP versions and both roles of go-ocpp share: the protocol versions and their WebSocket subprotocols, the contracts between the layers (Peer, Caller, Dispatcher), CALLERRORs and their codes, the sentinel errors, and the observability hooks. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-ocpp/client](client.md) | Package client is the Charging Station role of OCPP (OCPP 1.6: Charge Point): it connects to a CSMS, sends CALLs to it and answers the CALLs the CSMS sends. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-ocpp/ocppcert](ocppcert.md) | Package ocppcert computes the certificate identifiers OCPP messages carry: CertificateHashData, which GetInstalledCertificateIds, DeleteCertificate, GetCertificateStatus and the 1.6 Security Whitepaper messages use to name a certificate without sending it. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-ocpp/ocppj](ocppj.md) | Package ocppj is the OCPP-J RPC frame codec: the JSON arrays that carry OCPP messages over WebSocket. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-ocpp/ocpptest](ocpptest.md) | Package ocpptest helps applications test their OCPP handlers against a real go-ocpp peer over a WebSocket on the loopback interface, the way net/http/httptest helps test HTTP handlers. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-ocpp/server](server.md) | Package server is the CSMS role of OCPP (OCPP 1.6: Central System): it accepts charging stations' connections, answers their CALLs and sends CALLs to them. |
